description:
Add admin endpoints (gated by existing `requireAdmin()` middleware) for the five manual-recovery operations currently missing from LPBS (Findings 5, 8):

1. Customer payment/subscription lookup (read-only aggregate view: Stripe customer id, subscriptions, credit wallet, recent payments, anomalies)
2. Manual entitlement grant/revoke
3. Credit adjustment (generalized refund/grant/correction - replaces ad-hoc AI gateway refund path)
4. Stuck checkout-session viewer with a "reconcile now" action that runs the reconciliation ticker's logic for a single session
5. Failed-webhook viewer backed by `payment_anomaly_log` with a "retry processing" action

All actions must write to `payment_anomaly_log` with operator identity for audit. Integrates with the existing admin surface; no new admin auth model.
name: lpbs-admin-payment-ops
title: Admin payment ops: customer lookup, entitlement grant/revoke, credit adjustment, stuck-session viewer, manual reconciliation trigger
